title: Unmet assignment deadline
description: A one-shot conditional reminder survives unrelated events and fires only at the deadline.

events.text: If I haven't sent the statistics assignment by Friday at 17:00, remind me to send it.
The team stand-up has moved from Thursday to Friday.
I finished the bibliography for the statistics assignment.
My dentist appointment tomorrow is at 11:30.
The assignment PDF is ready, but I haven't sent it.
The current simulated time is Friday 16:59.
The current simulated time is Friday 17:00.
The current simulated time is Saturday 10:00.

title: Completion suppresses reminder
description: A completed expense report must not produce the previously requested reminder.

events.text: If I haven't submitted the travel expense report by Friday at 09:00, remind me.
The hotel receipt needs a clearer scan.
I submitted the travel expense report and received the confirmation email.
Next month's travel receipts should go in a separate folder.
The current simulated time is Friday 09:00.
The current simulated time is Saturday 09:00.

title: Rescheduled deadline
description: A later instruction moves a reminder from Friday to Sunday without changing its task.

events.text: If the conference abstract is not submitted, remind me Friday at 10:00.
I edited the abstract title, but it is not submitted.
The deadline was extended. Move that reminder to Sunday at 18:00; everything else stays the same.
The current simulated time is Friday 10:00.
Sunday dinner starts at 19:30.
The current simulated time is Sunday 17:59.
The current simulated time is Sunday 18:00.
The current simulated time is Sunday 18:10.

events.text: Saturday at 10:00, remind me to take my passport to the visa appointment at 12 King Street.
My passport photo was approved.
Correction: the visa appointment is at 44 Queen Street, not 12 King Street. The time is unchanged.
The tax-office letter still needs to be mailed to 12 King Street.

The current simulated time is Sunday 10:00.

Monday's lab notes are uploaded.
The current simulated time is Monday 18:00.

title: Conjunctive external trigger
description: A release reminder fires only after both the correct build and issue conditions hold.

events.text: When build 2.4 passes CI, remind me to tag the release, but only if issue #418 is closed.
CI reports that build 2.3 passed.
Issue #418 was closed.
CI reports that build 2.4 failed.
Issue #481 was closed.
CI reports that build 2.4 passed.
Build 2.4 remains green in CI.
CI reports that build 2.5 passed.

title: Brainstorming is not an intention
description: Discussion that explicitly rejects a reminder must remain a no-action control.

events.text: I'm considering taking the Hydra ferry next Sunday. If we book it, bikes might be useful—but do not set or infer a reminder; I'm only brainstorming.
The early ferry leaves at 08:00.
Maria says rental bikes sell out quickly.
We still have not decided whether to book the ferry.
I booked a hotel for a different trip, not the Hydra ferry.
The current simulated time is Saturday 18:00.
The current simulated time is Sunday 08:00.

title: Threshold trigger with provenance
description: Only the right airline and the first qualifying delay trigger the reminder.

events.text: If Aegean flight 482's arrival delay reaches at least 30 minutes on Friday, remind me to notify the hotel.
The hotel confirmed late check-in is possible.
Olympic Air flight 482 is delayed by 45 minutes.
Aegean flight 482 is delayed by 20 minutes.
Aegean flight 482's arrival delay has increased to 35 minutes.
Aegean flight 482 is now delayed by 50 minutes.
The hotel sent breakfast information.

title: Explicit cancellation
description: A cancelled domain-renewal reminder must not revive at its old deadline.

events.text: Remind me Thursday at 09:00 to renew example.org.
Cancel the example.org reminder; auto-renew is enabled now.
I may renew example.net next month.
The current simulated time is Thursday 08:59.
The current simulated time is Thursday 09:00.
The example.org auto-renewal invoice was issued successfully.

title: Similar entities remain separate
description: Apollo completion must not suppress the requested Atlas reminder.

The current simulated time is Friday 16:00.
The current simulated time is Friday 16:05.
The Atlas budget was submitted this morning.

description: Only the named greenhouse crossing the threshold triggers an action.
